coordinate_policy: Coordinates may be exact modern identification points or logical area anchors. They must never be interpreted as exact historical positions unless historical_match says otherwise. approximate_area coordinates exist to keep the follow-along map useful when the text supports an area but not a precise point.

locations.name: Sekigahara
locations.map_note: Modern Sekigahara area; narrative setting is the 1600 battlefield region.

locations.name: Monte Ibuki
locations.map_note: Modern Mount Ibuki reference point; the novel describes the surrounding mountain area rather than a precise summit point.

locations.name: Casa di Oko e Akemi
locations.map_note: Logical area anchor in the Ibuki foothills. The narrative places the house in the Ibuki area, but no precise modern house identification is justified.

locations.name: Shippoji
locations.map_note: Logical Miyamoto-area anchor. The narrative places Shippoji in Miyamoto; the exact historical temple site is not being asserted.

locations.name: Montagne di Sanumo
locations.map_note: Approximate mountain-area anchor west/southwest of Miyamoto, retained to make the narrative movement visible without pretending to know a precise point.

locations.name: Pascolo di Itadori
locations.map_note: Approximate area anchor on the Takateru mountain system. The novel describes a sloping pasture on the mountain rather than a precise surveyed point.

locations.name: Vecchio cryptomeria di Shippoji
locations.map_note: Uses the same Miyamoto/Shippoji area anchor because the text establishes the tree at Shippoji but does not provide a modern coordinate.

locations.name: Passo di Nakayama
locations.map_note: Approximate anchor for the Kamazaka Pass candidate in the Miyamoto area. The candidate is useful for the narrative route but is not asserted as an exact historical equivalence.

locations.name: Hinagura
locations.map_note: Approximate Sayo-side area anchor. The text places Hinagura near the provincial boundary and on Musashi's route toward Harima; the precise prison site remains unresolved.

locations.name: Hanada Bridge
locations.map_note: Modern literary identification around Ogawa Bridge/Otsu Park. This is deliberately a modern reference point, not a claim that the present bridge is the historical 1600 bridge.

locations.name: Castello di Himeji
locations.map_note: Modern Himeji Castle site; the castle complex is the narrative anchor.

locations.name: Teahouse sulla strada per Harima
locations.map_note: Logical Himeji-area anchor on the Harima approach. The novel identifies the teahouse by route context, not by a precisely identifiable modern site.
